item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable price for technological progress.

2. We oppose the race to build superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, the result will be a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand prevention, not promises.

3. We will not call a billion deaths an innovation trade-off. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe on that scale. We must stop this race before its consequences become irreversible.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe the defining responsibility of this moment is to prevent a catastrophe, not accelerate toward it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We will not soften that conclusion to make it more comfortable, and we will not accept those lives being wagered in a race for power and profit. We demand enforceable limits that stop the race to build superintelligent AI. Our task is to turn that demand into public pressure and political action. We choose human survival over technological ambition, and we are organising to make that choice count.
